title: Suppose G has n vertices and no induced copy of H
exact_target: For each forbidden induced graph, must every graph avoiding it have a clique or independent set of polynomial size? The five-cycle instance is established.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3100015 (AMR-030-0015). CC BY 4.0.
Maria Chudnovsky, Alex Scott, Paul Seymour and Sophie Spirkl, Erdos--Hajnal for Graphs with No 5-hole (2021), abstract and section 1, Conjecture 1.1 and the five-cycle result.
